parts.name: ComboboxRoot
parts.description: Holds the selection, the input's text and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it through the `combobox` context.

props.name: value
props.description: Single selection: the selected value, null for none.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value selected at first, when `value` isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when an option is chosen, the input is emptied or Clear is pressed (`null` for no selection).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Any number of values may be selected; they are then `values`, `defaultValues` and `onValuesChange`.

props.name: values
props.description: With `multiple`: the selected values. Pass it with `onValuesChange` to control them.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: With `multiple`: the values selected at first, when `values` isn't controlled.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: With `multiple`: called with the new values when an option is toggled, a chip removed or the selection cleared.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The input's text. By default it shows the selected option's label (single) or what was typed (multiple).

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: The input's text at first, when `inputValue` isn't controlled.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called with the input's new text: what was typed, or the label shown after a choice. It is called in a change of its own, after the combobox has taken the text in, so a handler that starts a request (`query := text` read by `await search(query)`) doesn't hold the input, the popup or the highlight while the answer is out.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is open at first, when `open` isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the popup opened or closed, whatever closed it.

props.name: filter
props.description: Whether an option labelled `label` matches what was typed.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Highlight the first matching option as the user types.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the arrow keys go from the last option back to the input, and on to the first.

props.name: openOnInputClick
props.description: Whether a click in the input opens the list.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the combobox is disabled. Also disabled inside a disabled `FieldRoot`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the selection can't be changed. The popup doesn't open.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a value must be selected for the form to submit. Validated by an enclosing `FieldRoot`.

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot) the selected value is submitted with a <form>; with `multiple`, one entry per value.

props.name: items
props.description: The label of each value, when it must be known before the option has rendered.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the options are being fetched: pass `pending? results` (and `results == null` before the first answer) for `results = await search(query)`. `ComboboxEmpty` stays empty, the list is `aria-busy`, and the popup and list carry `data-loading`.

parts.name: InputGroup
parts.description: Import from `./ui/glaze/input-group.rx`. Place the input, clear button, and optional trigger directly inside this group. It keeps the actions inside the field and aligns the popup with the full input width.

parts.name: ComboboxInput
parts.description: The text input, with `role="combobox"`. Typing filters the options and opens the popup; the arrow keys move the highlight while focus stays here; Enter chooses the highlighted option.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a value is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: ComboboxTrigger
parts.description: A button beside the input that opens and closes the popup and leaves focus in the input. It isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a value is required.

parts.name: ComboboxClear
parts.description: A button that clears the selection and the input's text, then focuses the input. It is rendered only while there is something to clear, and isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to render the button while there is nothing to clear.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a value is required.

parts.name: ComboboxValue
parts.description: The selected option's label, or the labels joined by ", " with `multiple`. Use it to show the selection somewhere other than the input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is selected (the value then carries `data-placeholder`).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while nothing is selected and the placeholder is shown.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when a value is required.

parts.name: ComboboxPopup
parts.description: The popup: an element with `popover="manual"`, placed against the input (or `ComboboxChips`) with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. A press inside it keeps focus in the input.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the input it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the input it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between input and popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the popup is moved along the input's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while no option is rendered (none matches what was typed, or the answer had none).

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the input the popup is on: the one asked for, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: ComboboxList
parts.description: The listbox that holds the options. The input's `aria-controls` points at it.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while no option is rendered (none matches what was typed, or the answer had none).

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true; the list is `aria-busy` then too.

parts.name: ComboboxItem
parts.description: An option. It isn't rendered while it doesn't match what was typed. A press or Enter while it is highlighted chooses it.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the option stands for.

props.name: label
props.description: The text the filter matches and the input shows once chosen.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the option can't be highlighted or chosen.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the option is highlighted: the input's `aria-activedescendant`.

dataAttributes.name: data-label
dataAttributes.description: The option's label: what the filter matches and the input shows once chosen.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the option's value is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The option's `value`.

parts.name: ComboboxItemIndicator
parts.description: A mark (a check) shown while its option is selected. Hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to render it while the option isn't selected too; style it with `data-selected`.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while its option is selected.

parts.name: ComboboxGroup
parts.description: Groups related options under a `ComboboxGroupLabel`. It gets `hidden` while none of its options match.

parts.name: ComboboxGroupLabel
parts.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: ComboboxEmpty
parts.description: A `role="status"` element whose children show while no option is rendered, except while the root is `loading`: "no results" isn't shown for an answer that hasn't come. The element stays in the document, empty, otherwise.

parts.name: ComboboxStatus
parts.description: A `role="status"` element with `aria-live="polite"`, for a message about the list, such as a result count.

parts.name: ComboboxSeparator
parts.description: A horizontal `role="separator"` between options or groups.

parts.name: ComboboxChips
parts.description: With `multiple`: the container of the chips and the input. When it is there, the popup is anchored to it rather than to the input.

parts.name: ComboboxChip
parts.description: One selected value. Render one per value in the `combobox` context's `selected`.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value the chip stands for. `ComboboxChipRemove` inside it removes this value.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the combobox is read-only.

parts.name: ComboboxChipRemove
parts.description: A button inside a chip that removes its value from the selection. It isn't a Tab stop. Give it an `aria-label`.

parts.name: ComboboxArrow
parts.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the input, centred on it. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the input the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
